scope: Command design only. All runtime tests remain planned; no product conformance, source-test adaptation, installed schema or release is claimed.
schemaContract: Typed documentary operation contracts. Each operation has a closed argument field list and domain types; generated runtime JSON Schema/help remain implementation work. Public API map target/default/error/ownership references are normative parts of the per-member schema contract.

json.description: One structured result on stdout; diagnostics on stderr.

limit.type: ReadonlyArray<{name: LimitName; value: nonnegative safe integer}>
limit.description: Repeat NAME=VALUE for distinct names only; lower host ceilings.

outputDir.description: Manifest output; transaction or explicit partial-output consent.

force.description: Only explicit output destinations; never bypass protection, alias or validation.

dryRun.description: Validate proposed effects without publication; output optional.

allowEmpty.description: Permit a mutation matching zero objects.

allowPartialOutput.description: Allow incapable adapter multi-file output with exact partial manifest.

select.description: Fingerprint and owning scope; emitted by inspection.

scope.description: Body default; all-stories deterministic graph order and shared-part deduplication.

all.description: Explicit all inside selected scope only.

timestamp.description: Explicit date; normalize to UTC whole seconds.

cell.description: A1 notation; reject ambiguous/unresolvable merged-cell edit.

rules.grammar: docx only; closed paths; options after full path; -- ends options. help/-h/--help, text/text get, --version and -o retained. pack takes positional inventory, rejects --inventory. Unknown/repeated/inapplicable options fail usage.
rules.selection: Opaque token and simple selectors are exclusive. Owner-scoped positions are one-based; SDK sequences zero-based. Ambiguity/staleness fails with bounded candidates; destructive edits require selection. --all never expands to implicit stories/shared resources.
rules.publication: Mutations require exactly output or inPlace except dryRun. create requires output except dryRun. Existing output requires force. Aliases of input require inPlace. Resolve VFS identities and conditional publication before writing; unknown alias/insufficient capability rejects. No prepublication failure changes old files.
rules.streams: Explicit positional - only for document stdin; never infer from omitted input. Exactly one stdin consumer including auxiliary file options. --raw conflicts with --pretty/--json; XML default bytes become encoded data with --json. Binary package output conflicts with --json except dryRun.
rules.batch: Envelope {version:1,operations:[{operation,arguments,receiver?,resultHandle?}]}. Only operation IDs enumerated here; every item uses its own closed arguments. Validate whole syntax then resolve semantics in staged order; budgets aggregate; one final publication. Unknown fields/IDs fail. No eval, dynamic arbitrary method/property lookup, prototype traversal or callbacks. Batch, discovery, independent top-level input acquisition, diff and multi-file publication commands are direct-only; they cannot recursively occur as batch items. Typed save/serialize stages bytes and registers its admitted destination for the single final commit; conflicting/multiple package destinations fail before effects, never publish mid-batch.
rules.handles: receiver is an opaque {id,type,owner,revision} handle returned by a preceding operation or input document root. resultHandle is a unique batch-local name. Check declared receiver type/owner/revision. Input capabilities referenced only through admitted descriptors; JSON cannot manufacture VFS authority. Collection/view results expose ordered owner-bound handles; bytes serialize as bounded base64 and dates as UTC strings. In batch JSON, receiver may instead be {resultHandle:string,index?:safe integer,key?:string}. Only one index/key is permitted and only for a declared returned sequence/keyed type. This selector performs its documented bounded at lookup; no property path, call name or prototype access. A direct selected get may emit a model resultHandle while its JSON data stays a noncreating snapshot.
rules.batchPublication: Read/value-only batch returns data with normal human/--json rendering and rejects publication flags. State-changing batches require publication except dryRun. Creating getters count as mutation. Detached values never imply publication.
rules.inspection: Ordinary inspect/list/get commands use noncreating queries. Explicit typed model get preserves documented creating side effects and reports affected objects. Whole text setters/clear are destructive within documented scope, unlike text replace.
rules.security: Explicit scoped VFS, owned bytes, original templates, limits, signal, time/author/font capabilities only. No ambient host I/O, environment discovery, implicit network, Python/native runtime, execution of fields/macros/objects, font installation or image conversion.
rules.support: capabilities classifies edit/read/preserve/reject per feature and subset, reports detected input needs and affected unsupported operations. Proposed entries never imply implemented support.
rules.json: OfficeResultV1 {version,operation,ok,data,warnings,errors,affected,locations}. Version 1; operation dotted ID. Reads/failed prepublication edits affected=0. Error data=null except explicit partial manifest. Stable bounded errors and deterministic ordering, no default document text leaks.
rules.units: Direct geometry accepts emu/in/cm/mm/pt only; no bare numbers or px. Batch Length additionally admits twip where target allows; numeric model values are integer EMUs. One rounding, nearest halfway away from zero. Image native DPI falls back per missing axis to 72.
rules.defaults: Concrete defaults and conditional requirements in docx.md section 6.5. Omitted edit fields unchanged; no null/coercion unless declared. Optional false, 0 and empty string retained. No implicit clock, random seed or default output. New CLI creation omits dates unless timestamp supplied; model factory required context remains distinct.
rules.preservation: Untouched parts retain identical uncompressed bytes; dirty XML preserves unselected semantics including comments/PI/whitespace/namespaces and alternate branches. Shared resources retained while referenced. Unsupported affected edits reject.
rules.selectorApplicability: A listed selector is accepted only in a valid owner chain for the operation (for example section -> header story -> paragraph -> run, or table -> cell -> paragraph). Unrelated resource selectors are usage errors, never ignored. Mutating one object requires a unique resolved target unless --all is explicitly supported. --all on fixed-schema single-object model operations is inapplicable.
rules.fingerprints: docx.md section 6.3: docx-loc-v1. canonical base64url JSON, SHA-256 admitted source bytes plus staged generation; exact owner/path/range guards, no fuzzy relocation.

diff.2: comparison failed, detailed stable error code

M-VALUES.contract: Omitted/undefined optional arguments apply only the listed default; required undefined rejects. null is explicit absence only in the union; never coalesce false, 0 or empty string. Model getters/mutations are sync. Strings/booleans are strict; numbers finite and integer where counts/IDs require. No coercion.
cases: Unset, null, false, zero, empty, undefined, wrong type; invalid assignment leaves bytes/model unchanged.

Font flags boolean|null; underline true/false/typed enum/null. Defined-style flags read false when reset, latent overrides read null. Core strings max 255 Unicode code points; astral characters count once.

M-KEYWORDS.contract: Source positional order and names retained; omit earlier optional parameter with undefined. Every source keyword-only group maps to one trailing typed options object with source-spelled keys; no source keyword-only parameters were found in this pin. No blanket named overload. Context/operation options are camelCase. Reserved TS binding package maps to owner_package, an argument binding change only.
M-KEYWORDS.example: model_method(positional: string, options?: { source_flag?: boolean }): void; illustrative rule, not an invented API.
cases: Compile retained spelling; reject camelCase model aliases, unknown option fields and ambiguous argument guessing.

M-SEQUENCE.contract: Zero-based readonly numeric lookup and at(index); negative at adds length; out of range throws BoundsError. Only Sections, _Rows and RGBColor expose source slicing: normalize/clamp endpoints, exclusive end, negatives from length, no mutation. Collections iterate in source order and length is live. Snapshot list/tuple returns are readonly arrays of live handles. SDK ordinal differs from one-based CLI.
cases: Three items: [0], at(-1), at(-4), at(3); empty collection; fractional/NaN index rejects.
slice(-2,3), slice(2,1), oversized bounds; Columns/InlineShapes/TabStops must not acquire slice by accident.
Merged cells alias; omitted cells absent; mutations invalidate removed handles; no wrapper allocation identity requirement.

M-KEYS.contract: Styles/LatentStyles at(string) retains source keyed lookup; no numeric index. Styles ID fallback remains deprecated and warns, get_by_id/default preserve documented fallback. Comments.get(comment_id) is nullable ID lookup. Relationships at(rId) throws, get(rId, default_value?) returns null/default; retain items spelling. Owner-scoped rIds never resolve globally.
cases: Missing style throws MissingKeyError; dangling style reference uses default; misspelled assignment fails.
Comment IDs [2,8] lookup 8 succeeds, ordinal 1 does not select 8.
Relationship null/default/throw distinctions, insertion order, pop last entry, duplicate owner conflict, atomic update.

M-UNITS.contract: Immutable Length/Emu/Inches/Cm/Mm/Pt/Twips; integer EMU storage <= Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER in magnitude. Factors per unit: 914400/in, 360000/cm, 36000/mm, 12700/pt, 635/twip. Finite conversion rounded once nearest, halfway away from zero; check safe range before/after. Twips accessor uses same rounding. Negative allowed only where property permits. No DOCX centipoint helper. Line spacing number means multiple, Length means exact distance.
cases: Inches(1).emu=914400, Pt(1).emu=12700, Twips(1).emu=635; +/- half ties; unsafe, fractional integer constructor, NaN and Infinity reject.
Negative indent accepted, negative image dimension rejected; explicit zero never becomes omitted default.

M-ENUM.contract: Immutable nominal enum symbols with stable number/name and optional xml_value; aliases share canonical identity. fromValue validates, members includes aliases, iterator emits canonical declaration order. from_xml/to_xml retain spellings; UNMAPPED fails. No dynamic enum construction or unvalidated bare-number substitution.
cases: Assert every row numeric/XML value and alias identity; unknown names/numbers reject; setter-specific allowed subset is separate from enum membership.

M-COLOR.contract: RGBColor immutable three integer channels 0..255; from_string exactly six ASCII hex digits, case-insensitive; toString six uppercase hex digits; reject whitespace/sign/prefix/nonhex/wrong length. RGB assignment clears theme; theme assignment may preserve compatibility RGB; type reports active color category.
cases: RGBColor(10,32,255) -> 0A20FF; reject -1/256/0.5; parse lowercase and reject seven digits; null differs from AUTO/theme.

M-BYTES.contract: Input Uint8Array copied before first asynchronous suspension; every yielded source chunk copied before next pull; reject SharedArrayBuffer-backed/racy or detached inputs. Output byte getters return fresh copies; no retained caller mutation races. Byte budgets include retained copies.
cases: Mutate caller bytes immediately after factory call; reuse source chunk; mutate blob getter result; none changes admitted state.
Over-limit copied bytes reject, cancelled source settles cleanup.

M-DATES.contract: Date denotes UTC instant; clone on get/set/context admission, reject Invalid Date. Serialize whole seconds by dropping fractional second after UTC normalization, including pre-epoch timestamps. Missing/invalid source dates read null with validation diagnostics. No timezone guess, ambient Date.now or local-clock formatting.
cases: Explicit offset instant normalizes to Z, .999 discarded, pre-epoch fractional value handled; invalid assigned Date rejects before mutation; returned Date mutation inert.

M-IO.contract: Input = Uint8Array | ByteSource | VfsPath; Document(input?: Input | null, context?: DocumentContext): Promise<DocumentModel>. Null/omission uses original template. save(output: ByteSink | VfsPath): Promise<void>. All input admission always async including image/part byte loads; model getters and admitted metadata stay sync. ByteSource.open(signal?) supplies AsyncIterable<Uint8Array>; ByteSink stages/commits/aborts owned output. Path requires explicit scoped VFS; no ambient host I/O/native runtime/network. Standalone Image.from_blob(blob: Uint8Array, context?: DocumentContext): Promise<Image> and Image.from_file(image_descriptor: Input, context?: DocumentContext): Promise<Image> use explicit context; package open also takes context. Omitted context uses intrinsic documented limits and grants no ambient capabilities.
cases: For bytes/stream/path verify actual Promise; property access returns value. Reject raw path strings and text streams.
Injected VFS permission/alias/force/in-place conflict, malformed package, source/sink failure, cancellation, atomic publication and input preservation.

M-CONTEXT.contract: DocumentContext = { vfs?: VfsCapability; limits?: Readonly<LimitOptions>; signal?: AbortSignal; timestamp?: Date; author?: string; fonts?: FontMetricsCapability; template?: Uint8Array }. No environment, implicit host clock/author/fonts. Creation/comments requiring timestamp reject if absent; context supplied author used only for operations explicitly choosing context author, source author default remains empty string. Font metrics capability returns admitted deterministic metrics, never discovers/loads host fonts. Template is original admitted bytes; empty context grants no I/O.
cases: Supply fixed timestamp/author/template/metrics; repeat produces same semantic package; missing required capability rejects.
Document() stays syntactically valid async factory; creation requiring timestamp fails without supplied context rather than reading clock.

M-OWNERSHIP.contract: Live models share document owner/revision, not wrapper identity. Snapshot sequences contain live handles. Deleted/replaced subtrees invalidate handles deterministically. Cross-owner assignment rejects without explicit import. TabStop.position preserves tab handle, refreshes element, invalidates detached old node. Read-only CLI queries must not call creating getters.
cases: Unlink/relink header, delete style, clear runs, merge cells, replace tab node; assert exactly which handles remain valid.
Read CLI inspect before/after yields unchanged package hash even if equivalent model getter creates a part.

M-VIEWS.contract: Bounded XmlElementView/PartView/PackageView/RelationshipView carry owner and capability; namespace/tag, text/tail, attributes, ordered typed nodes, bytes and scoped relationships only. Validated mutations reject required-node/reference/namespace/security violations and publication validates graph. No arbitrary XPath/eval/prototype lookup, raw dependency XML object, host paths, user marshal callbacks or external target dereference. Source load/new/constructors use admitted bytes/views and fixed validation. Unsupported native/private behavior is not silently offered.
cases: External URI stays data with zero reads; reject DTD/entities/traversal, stale/foreign handle and malformed relationship graph.
Create/remove relationship preserves shared targets; lifecycle preparation occurs at admission/save with no callback execution.

M-IMAGES.contract: PNG, JPEG JFIF/Exif, GIF87a/89a, BMP, little/big endian TIFF characterized with bounded pure JS parsing; original tiny fixtures. Native width uses horizontal DPI, height vertical DPI; missing axis DPI falls back 72. One specified dimension preserves aspect, two set both. Numeric raw dimensions are integer EMUs. No host decoding/fonts/network. sha1 is compatibility metadata, not identity/security hash; SHA-256 is evidence identity.
cases: Different horizontal/vertical DPI, absent DPI, one/two/no dimensions, malformed/truncated metadata, unsupported format, oversized pixel dimensions and limits.
Embedded predicate requires admitted embedded relation; linked-only image rejects .image without fetching.

M-ERRORS.contract: Neutral classes with stable code, bounded sanitized message and structured context. Direct source raises are local evidence, not exhaustive error set; model validation, callees and admission add the referenced categories. Missing nullable lookup remains null. Do not swallow errors or leak source/project identity.
cases: Wrong type -> InputTypeError extends TypeError; bad value -> InvalidValueError extends RangeError; bounds -> BoundsError extends RangeError; missing key -> MissingKeyError extends Error; semantic validation -> SemanticValidationError.
Check read/write failure atomicity and shared CLI exit translation; diff differences are successful data.

M-CLI.contract: C-CLI governs all rows; direct common commands plus closed typed batch entries for advanced behavior. Source-spelled model fields retained; batch operation arguments use mechanical camelCase. Type/value discovery through schema/capabilities; never arbitrary method invocation.
cases: Reject singular image/table/metadata and top-level replace. Same versioned schema validates CLI JSON and SDK operation options.

typeContracts.VfsPath: interface VfsPath { readonly path: string; readonly capability: VfsCapability }
typeContracts.StagedByteSink: interface StagedByteSink { write(chunk: Uint8Array): Promise<void>; commit(): Promise<void>; abort(): Promise<void> }
typeContracts.DocumentContext: interface DocumentContext { vfs?: VfsCapability; limits?: Readonly<LimitOptions>; signal?: AbortSignal; timestamp?: Date; author?: string; fonts?: FontMetricsCapability; template?: Uint8Array }
typeContracts.ExpandedName: interface ExpandedName { readonly namespaceURI: string; readonly localName: string }
typeContracts.XmlNodeInput: Validated discriminated declarative element/text/comment/processingInstruction input; no DTD/entity/callback nodes.
typeContracts.capabilities: VfsCapability exposes only explicitly granted scoped read and staged conditional write/transaction operations; no global filesystem. LimitOptions uses named ceilings in docx.md §7. FontMetricsCapability is caller-supplied deterministic metrics; no font discovery. These host adapter interfaces are requirements, not current package exports.
typeContracts.EnumType: interface EnumType<E> { fromValue(value: number): E; readonly members: ReadonlyMap<string, E>; [Symbol.iterator](): IterableIterator<E> }
typeContracts.Border: interface Border { style: "none" | "single" | "double" | "dotted" | "dashed"; width: Length; color: RGBColor; space?: Length }

additional_decisions: Relationships.get retains source spelling and nullable/default semantics; keyed at replaces throwing __getitem__, items retains source spelling. Earlier getOrNull/entries aliases are superseded.
No source keyword-only group exists in this pin; trailing typed source-spelled options rule remains mandatory for later discovered members.
LatentStyles.default_priority/load_count permit null reads/reset; next_paragraph_style setter permits null while getter returns self fallback.
docx.md §9 allowMissing wording conflicts with common allowEmpty; office-cli.md is authoritative: use allowEmpty, do not expose alias.

commandResolutions.evidence: public-api-map.json cli.path combined create / inspect and properties get / properties set
commandResolutions.resolution: Split direct paths and dotted IDs; distinct model get/set IDs with fixed schemas. No slash-containing command.
Errors are neutral schema/result contracts, not invocable batch operations. Source-branded IDs remain research only.

commandResolutions.evidence: public-api-map.json mapped.XmlElementView.text/tail signatures contain get/set but getter/setter fields are null
commandResolutions.resolution: Expose separate typed get and set operations with string|null value; bounded graph validation remains mandatory.

commandResolutions.evidence: public-api-map.json prose-workflow rows have zero-argument synthetic IDs and sync labels including input admission
commandResolutions.resolution: Map workflows to actual commands/member batches; loading/saving/images always async. No empty synthetic operations.

commandResolutions.evidence: docs/specs/docx.md section 9 allowMissing versus office-cli.md allowEmpty
commandResolutions.resolution: Shared authority wins: --allow-empty / allowEmpty only; no allowMissing alias.

commandResolutions.evidence: public-api-map.json interface constructor records and getter read/write adapters
commandResolutions.resolution: Owner types are discoverable schemas, obtained from owner graph; members have full batch routes. Direct read-only inspection never invokes creating model getters.

commandResolutions.evidence: public-api-map.json __getitem__ rows combine numeric access/at and sometimes slice; getter types also have index arguments
commandResolutions.resolution: Retain exact required index fields in get schemas. Split slice into a separate closed operation only for Sections, _Rows and RGBColor; no invented slicing on other collections.

commandResolutions.evidence: Inventory source signatures identify cls factories; API batch receiver inherited owner type even for static methods and enum-type protocols.
commandResolutions.resolution: Static operations need no instance receiver; fixed closed ID determines the declared type. Document receiver uses factory result DocumentModel. No dynamic class construction.

commandResolutions.evidence: Format register pack had zero input arity and --inventory, contrary to the shared one-input default.
commandResolutions.resolution: pack INVENTORY uses positional JSON input; --inventory rejects; - is its only stdin consumer.

commandResolutions.evidence: Optional direct arguments and result envelopes lacked concrete defaults and result data; broad profiles implied unrelated selectors.
commandResolutions.resolution: docx.md section 6 defines exact arity, closed schemas, typed data, applicable owner chains, conditional defaults and raw/JSON precedence.

commandResolutions.evidence: Grammar readback: revisions list default final hid deletions; scope body was attached to package-global resources; implicit pixels were not an accepted shared unit.
commandResolutions.resolution: Revision inventory defaults all; resource inventories use own owners; direct geometry uses shared explicit units only. Model APIs retain documented native sizing and spellings.

commandResolutions.evidence: Initial-section link-to-previous true is invalid; the direct register lacked initial definition deletion.
commandResolutions.resolution: Explicit headers.remove/footers.remove with section/variant selection; bounded read/edit result schemas and local/shared ownership semantics are recorded in the authoritative spec and task plan.

features.name: ZIP/OPC
features.requiredBehavior: Bounded stored/deflated read/write, CRC validation, safe names, content types and relationship graph. ZIP64 read within limits; reject multi-disk/encrypted archives.

features.name: Strict and Transitional
features.requiredBehavior: Detect both, read both, edit supported structures in the original dialect. No silent dialect conversion.

features.name: Macro-free templates
features.requiredBehavior: Read/create/edit `.docx` and macro-free `.dotx` with explicit output kind and correct content type. Reject macro-enabled mutations.

features.name: XML fidelity
features.requiredBehavior: Namespace-aware edits; retain unknown unmodified subtrees, attributes, comments, processing instructions, order and meaningful whitespace.

features.name: Markup compatibility
features.requiredBehavior: Handle `mc:Ignorable`, `MustUnderstand`, `ProcessContent` and `AlternateContent` according to a declared understood-namespace profile; preserve unselected branches.

features.name: Package inspection
features.requiredBehavior: Parts, content types, relationship edges, properties, signatures, protected/unsupported content and structural counts.

features.name: XML access
features.requiredBehavior: Raw part bytes, bounded pretty display and a validated explicit XML-part replacement operation; never regex-based editing.

features.name: Text extraction
features.requiredBehavior: Body and explicit story scopes, paragraphs, runs, tabs, breaks, lists, tables and field results with stable locations.

features.name: Unicode and language
features.requiredBehavior: Lossless Unicode, RTL/bidirectional and East Asian properties, locale/font metadata and combining characters. No visual-order reshaping in logical text.

features.name: Literal replacement
features.requiredBehavior: Cross-run matching within explicit structural boundaries; exact first/all/occurrence selection; preserve outside text and formatting.

features.name: New documents
features.requiredBehavior: Create a minimal valid document or populate a supplied template from typed structured content.

features.name: Run formatting
features.requiredBehavior: Bold, italic, underline, strike, size, font references, color/theme references, highlight, language, baseline/superscript and hidden-text properties.

features.name: Paragraph formatting
features.requiredBehavior: Alignment, indentation, spacing, tabs/leaders, borders/shading, keep/widow controls, page/column breaks and outline level.

features.name: Styles and themes
features.requiredBehavior: Inspect/reuse/create/edit paragraph, character and table styles; inheritance, defaults and linked styles; preserve theme resources and unknown settings.

features.name: Headings
features.requiredBehavior: Level 0 creates a title; levels 1–9 use valid paragraph/outline styles; avoid overwriting colliding user styles.

features.name: Sections and pages
features.requiredBehavior: Page size/orientation/margins, columns, section breaks, page-number metadata, first/even/odd header/footer bindings and inherited sections.

features.name: Headers and footers
features.requiredBehavior: Scoped read/edit/create with explicit link-to-previous/shared-part behavior.

boundedImplementation.limits: Utility story lifecycle and existing scoped text/paragraph/table-cell and image-location primitives only; general table/image editors and live model/batch remain pending.

features.name: Lists
features.requiredBehavior: Multilevel ordered/bulleted lists, restart/start overrides, numbering styles and scoped ID allocation; preserve picture-bullet resources.

features.name: Tables
features.requiredBehavior: Create/read/edit rows/cells and formatting, grid widths, header repetition, row splitting, nesting and cell margins.

features.name: Merged tables
features.requiredBehavior: Resolve horizontal/vertical spans, target logical cells, explicit merge/split, validate rectangular grids and reject ambiguous coordinates.

features.name: Links and bookmarks
features.requiredBehavior: Internal/external hyperlink relationships, safe schemes, bookmark ranges/names and explicit rename/removal reference policy.

features.name: Fields and references
features.requiredBehavior: Simple/complex/nested field inventory; set displayed results without execution; create bounded PAGE/NUMPAGES/REF/PAGEREF/SEQ/TOC fields and update flags.

features.name: TOC and captions
features.requiredBehavior: Create/edit TOC field structures, figure/table captions and cross-reference relationships; cached page numbers are not recalculated promises.

features.name: Footnotes and endnotes
features.requiredBehavior: Read/insert/edit/remove notes, references and required separators; preserve numbering rules and scoped IDs.

features.name: Comments
features.requiredBehavior: Classic comment ranges and bodies; create/edit/delete with explicit author/time; modern/threaded extension inventory and preservation.

features.name: Tracked changes
features.requiredBehavior: Original/final/all read views; create simple text insert/delete revisions; accept/reject supported selected revisions and formatting changes atomically.

features.name: Complex review structures
features.requiredBehavior: Move revisions, table/section revisions and unsupported threaded metadata: inventory and preserve; reject affected edits until verified.

features.name: Content controls
features.requiredBehavior: Inspect/fill supported plain/rich text, checkbox, choice, date and picture controls; respect locked states and placeholders.

features.name: Repeating/data-bound controls
features.requiredBehavior: Bounded repeat-row/section expansion and explicit supported custom-XML binding synchronization; no arbitrary XPath evaluation or silent detachment.

features.name: Document properties
features.requiredBehavior: Core/extended/custom typed properties and explicit removal; preserve unrelated metadata.

features.name: Image inventory
features.requiredBehavior: Inline/floating image locations, owners, relationships, media type/bytes, dimensions, crop, rotation, wrapping and alt text.

features.name: Raster insertion/replacement
features.requiredBehavior: Documented API image-format coverage, including PNG/JPEG/GIF/BMP/TIFF with bounded header/dimension/DPI admission; occurrence versus shared-resource replacement and aspect-ratio sizing.

features.name: Floating image layout
features.requiredBehavior: Read/edit anchor coordinates, relative frames, wrap mode, z-order, crop, rotation/flips and decorative/alt metadata without claiming rendered geometry.

features.name: Other media formats
features.requiredBehavior: Preserve and extract original GIF/BMP/TIFF/EMF/WMF/WDP/SVG bytes and fallback relationships; no native decoding or conversion.

features.name: SVG and alternate graphics
features.requiredBehavior: Inventory/preserve SVG plus raster fallback; insertion requires supplied admitted SVG and explicit fallback. Reject external references/scripts; do not rasterize.

features.name: Shapes and text boxes
features.requiredBehavior: Inspect/preserve DrawingML/VML shapes; edit supported text-box story text without changing geometry; grouped/unsupported geometry stays opaque.

features.name: Charts
features.requiredBehavior: Inventory chart type/series/cached values and embedded-workbook bindings; preserve chart/workbook bytes on unrelated edits. No formula engine or chart rendering.

features.name: SmartArt and diagrams
features.requiredBehavior: Inventory graph/data/layout parts and preserve them. No diagram layout generation.

features.name: Equations
features.requiredBehavior: Inventory and preserve OMML; insert/replace validated bounded OMML fragments explicitly. No implied LaTeX conversion or math evaluation.

features.name: Embedded OLE/packages
features.requiredBehavior: Inventory and preserve inert objects/relationships; explicit bounded extraction only. Never activate embedded content.

features.name: Custom XML and glossary
features.requiredBehavior: Inventory/preserve custom XML, bindings, glossary/building-block and ancillary parts; support only declared structural edits.
features.supportedSubset: Structural binding edits only through F29 controls.bind; opaque custom XML/glossary has no editing command.

features.name: Settings/fonts/protection
features.requiredBehavior: Inspect/preserve compatibility, document settings and embedded fonts; respect editing protection. No password cracking or font installation.
features.supportedSubset: Documented Settings model only; remaining settings/fonts/protection are inspect/preserve; no bypass.

features.name: Signatures
features.requiredBehavior: Detect/list signature parts; default mutation rejection. An explicit strip-signatures operation removes the signature graph before edits; never claim signatures remain valid.

features.name: Removal
features.requiredBehavior: Exact range/structure removal with reference checks; retain shared resources and required empty containers.

features.name: Dummy text
features.requiredBehavior: Seeded deterministic replacement of selected visible text; not an anonymization guarantee.

features.name: Sanitization
features.requiredBehavior: Explicit, enumerated removal of selected properties/comments/revisions/links/embedded objects, with an exact report; never an unqualified privacy guarantee.

features.name: Batch and templates
features.requiredBehavior: Versioned typed ordered operations, bounded record expansion and one final publication; no eval or document-supplied code.

features.name: Comparison
features.requiredBehavior: Part-payload and semantic XML/text/structure diff; distinguish data differences from serialization changes.

features.name: Validation
features.requiredBehavior: Scoped OPC, XML and cross-part semantic diagnostics with an honest schema/profile report.

features.name: Extract/pack
features.requiredBehavior: Safe VFS extraction and reconstruction with validated inventories and no host utility fallback.

sdkBehaviors.contract: Omitted/undefined optional arguments apply only the listed default; required undefined rejects. null is explicit absence only in the union; never coalesce false, 0 or empty string. Model getters/mutations are sync. Strings/booleans are strict; numbers finite and integer where counts/IDs require. No coercion.

Source positional order and names retained; omit earlier optional parameter with undefined. Every source keyword-only group maps to one trailing typed options object with source-spelled keys; no source keyword-only parameters were found in this pin. No blanket named overload. Context/operation options are camelCase. Reserved TS binding package maps to owner_package, an argument binding change only.

Zero-based readonly numeric lookup and at(index); negative at adds length; out of range throws BoundsError. Only Sections, _Rows and RGBColor expose source slicing: normalize/clamp endpoints, exclusive end, negatives from length, no mutation. Collections iterate in source order and length is live. Snapshot list/tuple returns are readonly arrays of live handles. SDK ordinal differs from one-based CLI.

Styles/LatentStyles at(string) retains source keyed lookup; no numeric index. Styles ID fallback remains deprecated and warns, get_by_id/default preserve documented fallback. Comments.get(comment_id) is nullable ID lookup. Relationships at(rId) throws, get(rId, default_value?) returns null/default; retain items spelling. Owner-scoped rIds never resolve globally.

Immutable Length/Emu/Inches/Cm/Mm/Pt/Twips; integer EMU storage <= Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER in magnitude. Factors per unit: 914400/in, 360000/cm, 36000/mm, 12700/pt, 635/twip. Finite conversion rounded once nearest, halfway away from zero; check safe range before/after. Twips accessor uses same rounding. Negative allowed only where property permits. No DOCX centipoint helper. Line spacing number means multiple, Length means exact distance.

Immutable nominal enum symbols with stable number/name and optional xml_value; aliases share canonical identity. fromValue validates, members includes aliases, iterator emits canonical declaration order. from_xml/to_xml retain spellings; UNMAPPED fails. No dynamic enum construction or unvalidated bare-number substitution.

RGBColor immutable three integer channels 0..255; from_string exactly six ASCII hex digits, case-insensitive; toString six uppercase hex digits; reject whitespace/sign/prefix/nonhex/wrong length. RGB assignment clears theme; theme assignment may preserve compatibility RGB; type reports active color category.

Input Uint8Array copied before first asynchronous suspension; every yielded source chunk copied before next pull; reject SharedArrayBuffer-backed/racy or detached inputs. Output byte getters return fresh copies; no retained caller mutation races. Byte budgets include retained copies.

Date denotes UTC instant; clone on get/set/context admission, reject Invalid Date. Serialize whole seconds by dropping fractional second after UTC normalization, including pre-epoch timestamps. Missing/invalid source dates read null with validation diagnostics. No timezone guess, ambient Date.now or local-clock formatting.

Input = Uint8Array | ByteSource | VfsPath; Document(input?: Input | null, context?: DocumentContext): Promise<DocumentModel>. Null/omission uses original template. save(output: ByteSink | VfsPath): Promise<void>. All input admission always async including image/part byte loads; model getters and admitted metadata stay sync. ByteSource.open(signal?) supplies AsyncIterable<Uint8Array>; ByteSink stages/commits/aborts owned output. Path requires explicit scoped VFS; no ambient host I/O/native runtime/network. Standalone Image.from_blob(blob: Uint8Array, context?: DocumentContext): Promise<Image> and Image.from_file(image_descriptor: Input, context?: DocumentContext): Promise<Image> use explicit context; package open also takes context. Omitted context uses intrinsic documented limits and grants no ambient capabilities.

DocumentContext = { vfs?: VfsCapability; limits?: Readonly<LimitOptions>; signal?: AbortSignal; timestamp?: Date; author?: string; fonts?: FontMetricsCapability; template?: Uint8Array }. No environment, implicit host clock/author/fonts. Creation/comments requiring timestamp reject if absent; context supplied author used only for operations explicitly choosing context author, source author default remains empty string. Font metrics capability returns admitted deterministic metrics, never discovers/loads host fonts. Template is original admitted bytes; empty context grants no I/O.

Live models share document owner/revision, not wrapper identity. Snapshot sequences contain live handles. Deleted/replaced subtrees invalidate handles deterministically. Cross-owner assignment rejects without explicit import. TabStop.position preserves tab handle, refreshes element, invalidates detached old node. Read-only CLI queries must not call creating getters.

Bounded XmlElementView/PartView/PackageView/RelationshipView carry owner and capability; namespace/tag, text/tail, attributes, ordered typed nodes, bytes and scoped relationships only. Validated mutations reject required-node/reference/namespace/security violations and publication validates graph. No arbitrary XPath/eval/prototype lookup, raw dependency XML object, host paths, user marshal callbacks or external target dereference. Source load/new/constructors use admitted bytes/views and fixed validation. Unsupported native/private behavior is not silently offered.

PNG, JPEG JFIF/Exif, GIF87a/89a, BMP, little/big endian TIFF characterized with bounded pure JS parsing; original tiny fixtures. Native width uses horizontal DPI, height vertical DPI; missing axis DPI falls back 72. One specified dimension preserves aspect, two set both. Numeric raw dimensions are integer EMUs. No host decoding/fonts/network. sha1 is compatibility metadata, not identity/security hash; SHA-256 is evidence identity.

Neutral classes with stable code, bounded sanitized message and structured context. Direct source raises are local evidence, not exhaustive error set; model validation, callees and admission add the referenced categories. Missing nullable lookup remains null. Do not swallow errors or leak source/project identity.

C-CLI governs all rows; direct common commands plus closed typed batch entries for advanced behavior. Source-spelled model fields retained; batch operation arguments use mechanical camelCase. Type/value discovery through schema/capabilities; never arbitrary method invocation.

limitContract: These are proposed defaults from docx.md section 7. Per-document input/expanded accounting and aggregate retained/work accounting are distinct; diff charges both. Counts requiring nonzero capacity reject zero. No unknown limit names or ceilings above trusted context; no claims of corpus-qualified defaults.

schemaEncoding.domainTypes: Named types link public-api-map.json#/type_contracts and each modelContract; model enum/value/default/validation rules are carried by apiContract, never unconstrained any. This register is a typed documentary schema source, not generated executable JSON Schema.
schemaEncoding.inputs: CLI file/path arguments become explicitly scoped VFS descriptors. Batch Input fields use {kind:"bytes",base64:string} or {kind:"vfs",path:string,capability:string}; capability names resolve only in admitted context. Byte streams are SDK-only transports for the same behavior, reachable from CLI stdin. Binary-size budgets apply before decoded allocation.
schemaEncoding.length: Direct flags use only emu/in/cm/mm/pt suffix (no px); batch uses {value:finite number,unit:"emu"|"in"|"cm"|"mm"|"pt"|"twip"}, validated against the exact target unit type; numeric model dimensions remain safe integer EMUs. Line spacing distinguishes {multiple:number} from length.
schemaEncoding.enums: Batch enum input {enum:neutral type name,name:documented symbol}; closed documented aliases and setter subsets only. Result includes name, value and optional xmlValue. CLI property flags accept declared symbolic names; no guessed numbers.
schemaEncoding.null: Nullable CLI property values accept literal null; text flags preserve literal text including "null". Destructive nullable text resets use typed batch value:null. Presence-only control flags differ from explicit true/false/null property flags.
schemaEncoding.structured: Closed structured content, binding, inventory and output types are specified in docx.md section 6.6. Per-operation fields remain closed, with exact types and fixed typed-model receivers; no arbitrary dynamic dispatch.
schemaEncoding.limits: JSON source <= xmlPartBytes, total JSON values <= xmlNodes, nesting <= xmlDepth, all strings/decoded bytes charged to retainedBytes. Same names and lower-only host limits; duplicate keys and nonfinite/unsafe integers reject.
